forum.title: STM32MP1 DDR Routing Rules
forum.category: STM32 MPUs Products and hardware related
forum.best_answer_content:
Hi @LH1

Please confirm you are using the excel given for the correct package as given in [STM32MP15x Series DDR memory routing guidelines examples ?](https://www.st.com/resource/en/hw_model/stm32mp15x-series-ddr-memory-routing-guidelines-examples.zip)

e.g. "Memory\_length\_equalization\_in\_mm\_for\_STM32MP15XXAA.xls" for the LFBGA448

Delta value in 'blue' mean it is within guidelines.

Depending on the tool used to extract the signal lengths, there might be slight differences (e.g. how PCB vias are included in the length, etc...).

You should also check [AN5122 STM32MP1 Series DDR memory routing guidelines](https://www.st.com/resource/en/application_note/an5122-stm32mp1-series-ddr-memory-routing-guidelines-stmicroelectronics.pdf)

Regards,
forum.content_text: I entered the lengths of the DDR traces from the ST official evaluation board into Excel, and the maximum length deviation is 3 mm. Is the trace routing on the evaluation board reasonable, and can I reuse it directly on my own board?
forum.author: LH1
